page.overview:
What is Ice Planet 2002?

Ice Planet 2002 is a sub-theme of LEGO Space introduced in 1993. It was largely discontinued in 1994, although some Ice Planet sets were released in later years.

Ice Planet 2002 represents a "civilian" space affiliation similar to M-Tron and led by Commander Cold. They were conducting top secret research in rocket science, which made them a target for Spyrius, Blacktron Future Generation, and even renegade forces within Space Police II.

However, mini-story included in catalogues implied they are far from helpless: Blacktron Future Generation were defeated by combined efforts of Space Police II and Ice Planet 2002 when Blacktron invaded Ice Planet without proper equipment. Next year, they helped against Spyrius.

The distinctive hostile, icy setting of the ice planet Krysto meant that most of its vehicles were ground-based, and most were outfitted with the series' signature trans-neon-orange satellite dishes, skis and cockpit coverings. Many other elements were made in this colour, including helmet visors, rockets and chainsaws.
